A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same Any2AnyTryon research work, with all 13 pages and Appendices A–B available. Text and rendered pages 2–13 are identical; differences are confined to first-page affiliation text and version metadata.

before.justification: v1 reports original quantitative evaluations and ablations in Tables 2–5, alongside generated-image comparisons and additional qualitative results in Appendix B.

after.justification: v2 retains the original quantitative evaluations, ablations, and qualitative generation results, including those in Appendix B.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the identical FLUX.1-based framework, LoRA training, adaptive position embeddings, clean condition latents, and conditional flow-matching objective.

E1.justification: The LAION-Garment training coverage and VITON-HD evaluations are unchanged. Both versions cover garment reconstruction, model-free virtual try-on, virtual try-on, and layered try-on, with identical shop and wild examples in the appendices.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical: TryOffDiff in Table 2; Magic Clothing and StableGarment in Table 3; GP-VTON, OOTD, IDM-VTON, CatVTON, and FitDiT in Table 4; and DiOr in Figure 7.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 retains the same training resolutions, stages, optimizer settings, and dataset counts. The paired/unpaired comparisons and evaluation metrics described in Appendix A are identical.

E4.justification: Section 4.6 and Table 5 retain the same ablations removing clean condition latents or adaptive position embeddings. No sensitivity, robustness, error analysis, or qualitative case study is added or removed.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or statistical significance tests. Uncertainty reporting is unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 2–5 and all qualitative results, including Appendix B, are identical. For example, Table 4 retains the proposed method's unpaired FID of 8.965 and KID of 0.981.

T1.justification: Equations 1–10 and their mathematical definitions and explanations are unchanged. Neither version adds or removes formal assumptions, theorems, proofs, or derivations.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about the unified mask-free framework, LAION-Garment dataset, adaptive position embeddings, and generation quality and flexibility.

C2.justification: The explanations of spatial alignment and background preservation, interpretations of comparative and ablation results, and appendix discussions are identical. No limitations or applicability qualifications are added or removed.

D1.justification: The dataset-construction and implementation details in Sections 3.3 and 4.1 are identical, including model versions, resolutions, and optimizer information. The project URL and other resource-link destinations are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, research-positioning statements elsewhere, and all 59 references are unchanged. No cited work or relationship to prior research is added or revised.

P1.justification: Yiren Song's National University of Singapore affiliation changes from 'China' to 'Singapore' in the author heading and contact information. The arXiv stamp updates from v1 dated 27 January 2025 to v2 dated 26 March 2025; the research prose and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: The longer affiliation slightly reflows the first-page author-contact text, and the marginal arXiv stamp changes. Figures 1–13, Tables 1–5, their captions and placement, and every subsequent page layout remain identical.

improvement.justification: v2 corrects an affiliation country, improving front-matter accuracy. The methods, empirical evidence, explanations, reproducibility information, and appendices are identical, so this correction and its minor typesetting effects do not meaningfully change the paper's overall quality.
